note: SQUEEZE-KR-V1 baseline (STEP 1). TTM Squeeze (John Carter, Mastering the Trade ch.11) as standardized by the LazyBear Squeeze Momentum + StockCharts TTM implementations: squeeze on = BB(20,2.0,pop std) fully inside KC(20,1.5, SMA(TR,20)); RELEASE = previous bar on -> current bar off. Entry on RELEASE with momentum>0; exit on momentum crossing 0 from above. Long only, no pyramiding, no leverage. Momentum = 20-period linear regression endpoint of (Close - composite), composite = ((Highest(H,20)+Lowest(L,20))/2 + SMA(C,20))/2. Dynamic state-machine exit (momentum zero-cross) is not expressible in engine.executor's fixed STOP/TARGET/TIME contract, so this strategy is driver-driven exactly like MACD-KR-V1: engine DATA layer (A2aProvider/UniverseProvider/calendar/_drop_suspension_rows), engine PORTFOLIO accounting (engine.portfolio.Portfolio), CostModel, engine.metrics - not engine.executor.simulate_trade.

keltner.trueRange: TR = max(H-L, |H-prevClose|, |L-prevClose|), prevClose = prior bar close

signal.exit: Momentum crosses 0 from above (Momentum[t] < 0 AND Momentum[t-1] >= 0)

exit.note: Momentum zero-cross exit is a dynamic (state-machine) exit, NOT a static stop/target/time. Implemented in the research driver, not engine.executor.

pit.rule: no signal on/before ticker's A1a listedAt. Gateway applied at the signal date t: t < listedAt -> signal discarded. Entry is at next_session(t) so it is necessarily after listedAt.

period.note: Indicator warm-up uses pre-2016 bars; only trades with signal_date >= performanceStart are generated/measured.
